faq.title: Questions Everyone Asks
faq.sub: Didn't find your answer? Contact us on WhatsApp.

items.q: How do I create a new invitation?
items.a: Create your event in four easy steps: First, add your event details — name, venue, date, and time, with a location pin on the map. Second, add guests one by one or import your full list from a CSV file in one click. Third, choose an invitation image from our library or upload your own and add any text you like. Fourth, select a WhatsApp message template, review all your event details, send yourself a test message to see what your guests will receive, then schedule the send time — we'll deliver all invitations at your chosen moment with an automatic reminder 48 hours before the event.

items.q: Can I add my own custom design?
items.a: Absolutely. You can upload your own designs or choose from our premium template library and customize them with your preferred colors and text, or request professional design services through the 'Halla Marketplace' by connecting directly with one of our talented designers.

items.q: Can I see attendance and RSVP details?
items.a: Yes, your dashboard shows in real time who accepted, who declined, and who hasn't responded yet, with comprehensive exportable detailed reports.

items.q: Can I send reminders to guests?
items.a: Yes, Halaa automatically sends a WhatsApp reminder to every guest 48 hours before the event — no action needed from you.

items.q: What about guests who don't use WhatsApp?
items.a: Halaa sends invitations via WhatsApp by default. If a WhatsApp message doesn't reach a guest for any reason, the system automatically falls back to SMS to ensure the invitation is delivered.

items.q: Can I invite guests from outside Saudi Arabia?
items.a: Currently, the Halaa platform and app support sending invitations to mobile numbers within Saudi Arabia only.

items.q: Can I assign more than one additional host?
items.a: Yes, you can add one or more co-hosts to your event, allowing them to send invitations and track guest responses on your behalf.

items.q: What is the compensation credit system?
items.a: Compensation credits are extra invite slots granted on top of your plan's guest count. When a guest declines, you can use these credits to invite someone else in their place and ensure your event is fully attended.

items.q: Is my data safe with Halaa?
items.a: Yes, we use the highest security and encryption standards to protect your data and your guests' data, in accordance with international best practices and data protection regulations.

items.q: Can I try the Halaa platform for free?
items.a: Yes, you can create a new account for free and try the platform with a limited number of trial invitations.

items.q: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
items.a: Yes, you can cancel anytime with no additional fees. Your subscription continues until the end of the paid period and the prepaid plan amount is non-refundable.
